hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH/phiEth custom curve swap by intercepting beforeSwap, converting ETH to phiEth via deposit or withdrawing phiEth to ETH, then settling output and returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass concentrated liquidity. Adding liquidity to the pool is blocked; the hook only supports the phiEth/ETH pair with zero fee.
